digest.component_or_area: scripts/ import convention and test infrastructure
propositions: Bare imports of alert_dedup in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py fail when those test modules are run as subsets because scripts/ is not on sys.path
Full CI test runs pass because scripts/ is inserted on sys.path by tests/scripts/conftest.py at collection time, creating a divergence between full-suite and subset-run behavior
The fix requires explicit sys.path.insert derived from __file__ immediately above each bare sibling import, following the pattern established in scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py
A new guard test (tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py) must AST-scan scripts/ for unguarded bare sibling imports and verify via subprocess that affected modules collect when run standalone
Five sibling-import sites across scripts/ were swept; two required fixes (canary_bridge.py and dependency_audit.py), three were already safe via existing path inserts
